question: Who among the following was the founder of the Gurjara-Pratihara dynasty in the region of Malwa in the eighth century?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Nagabhatta I**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Nagabhatta I** was the founder of the **Gurjara-Pratihara dynasty** in the region of **Malwa **in the eighth century.
 
• The Gurjara-Pratihara dynasty played a significant role in resisting Arab invasions in western India.
